title: Pantalla Dividida de Moda: Ropa Flat-Lay en Caja Sombra con Fotografía de Modelo en Ilusión 3D
prompt: Create a vertical split-screen creative product photography composition on a clean white wall background with high-resolution photorealistic commercial advertisement quality. The top section features an exquisite light oak wooden shadow box frame mounted on the wall displaying a specific outfit as an artistic flat-lay museum specimen: a sleek midnight blue silk kimono-style robe with delicate silver cherry blossom embroidery and a matching obi sash. The garments are neatly pinned in place, surrounded by small thematic decorative props including dried sakura branches, a vintage ceramic sake cup, and silver origami cranes. Elegant calligraphy on the matte paper backdrop reads 'Tokyo Nights' in both English and Japanese characters. Soft studio lighting accentuates the rich texture and drape of the silk fabric. The bottom section creates a hyperrealistic naked-eye 3D illusion with a rectangular picture-frame border sitting directly beneath the top box. A stunningly realistic young Japanese woman with long straight black hair, subtle bronze eyeshadow, and a serene confident gaze wears the exact same outfit as shown above. She lounges gracefully on the bottom edge of the frame with one leg bent and foot resting inside the frame while her other leg elegantly dangles out into the viewer's space. Her torso leans back slightly with her elbow resting on her raised knee and fingers lightly grazing the silk fabric near her collarbone. Her body forms a soft sensual S-curve that highlights the garment's flowing silhouette without overt exposure. She looks directly at the camera with a calm knowing smile that is inviting yet enigmatic. This dynamic lifelike pose creates powerful visual tension between the static archival display above and living reality below. Technical specifications include soft natural shadows, ambient occlusion, bright and airy yet cinematic lighting, 8K resolution, vivid but refined color palette, ultra-detailed fabric textures showing silk sheen and embroidery detail, shallow depth of field, Vogue editorial style with filmic grain and professional fashion photography quality. Avoid blur, low resolution, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, deformed hands, cartoon or anime style, doll-like or plastic skin, overexposure, cluttered background, text errors, mismatched clothing, floating objects, and unrealistic proportions.
